title: Pavel Durov: three days in Paris police custody and the personal cost of running Telegram
summary: A personal narrative from Durov about his August 2024 detention in Paris, learning of his partner Julia's pregnancy, and the online hostility she faced. It contains almost no business, growth, or product insight, only a glimpse of his composure under pressure.

principles.text: Stay calm under extreme pressure; Durov kept composure through custody and sudden news.
principles.quote: I remained calm throughout my time in police custody, but this turn of events caught me off guard.
